criteria.criterion: Criterion H1: The policy prohibits discrimination, including on grounds relevant to Indigenous identity

hits.label: Bans discrimination and harassment in hiring and promotion
Names ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, creed
Explicitly protects First Nations, Inuit and Métis applicants

criteria.criterion: Criterion H3: Indigenous-specific hiring follows Ontario Human Rights Commission guidance

hits.label: Special program under section 14 of the Code
States purpose: under-representation in clinical leadership roles
Designates Patient Navigator roles for Indigenous applicants
Self-identification voluntary; community letter confirmation option
Identity information kept separately from hiring file

criteria.criterion: Criterion H5: Retention and advancement supports exist

hits.label: Formal senior sponsor for new Indigenous hires
Published, objective promotion criteria for each level
Panels record reasons for promotion decisions
Indigenous Employee Circle with budget and sponsor
